name: Abyss Drakon
description: A legendary abyss dragon that learns an opponent's successful actions and turns repetition against them.

ability.name: Void Reversal
ability.description: Abyss Drakon remembers the opponent's last successful action. If that same action is used again within 2 rounds, it creates a Void Copy and retaliates with a corrupted effect. Attack reflects 40% of damage dealt as bonus damage; Defense steals 20% of DEF used for 1 round; Stamina steals 3 Stamina; Charge gains 50% of the Charge gained; Special grants Void Seal, reducing the enemy's next Special damage by 30%. The same action type can trigger Void Reversal only once every 3 rounds.

special_move.name: Nightmare Rift
special_move.description: Abyss Drakon tears open an abyssal rift. Deals 145 base damage with +45% ATK scaling, ignores 20% DEF, and gains +15% bonus damage for each different Void Copy stored. At 5 different copied actions, Perfect Nightmare Rift adds 50 bonus damage, ignores 25% DEF, and removes 1 positive enemy effect.
flavour_texts: 🌑 **Nightmare Rift** — the abyss remembers every move!
